title: Bound complete selected BIT adapter numerical lifetimes
body:
## Summary

PR2770 bounds an initialized evaluator and PR2778 bounds isolated form constructors. This adds the complete closed adapter-coefficient lifetime for unchanged PR2697, above **all** numerical entry residents:

```text
selected_coefficient, adapter branch
  Callback initialization and validation
  current projector preparation
  good/fallback form construction
  Page.evaluate
  close form, columns and callback

additional residue Words <= 37,672
additional index Words   <= 22
```

A complete rank-42 call attains the residue bound. Only `research/selected-adapter-numerical-lifecycle/` is added, with a written lifetime proof, six byte-identical source modules and their complete notice, exact pins, an independent integer fixture oracle, fixed receipt and registered replay.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959295). Scope changes from the historical helper-contract suggestion to the live selected numerical-overlap handoff. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 algorithms; Nick Petalas's PR2759/2770/2778 components; David Arias's PR2753 coarser logical inventory and the retained source lineage. Exact heads and attribution are in TASK.json and SNAPSHOT.json.

## Evidence

- **Before:** An initialized-Page allowance does not include its simultaneously retained projector and constructor matrices. **After:** The closed entry point fits the source-derived 37,672/22 allowance; a literal F3 rank-42 call attains 37,672. Nested fallback evaluation separately reaches 36,877.
- **Before:** Fixture teardown could conceal source leaks or an insufficient construction allowance. **After:** Twelve optimized controls check actual source rollback before teardown, including a one-Word-underbudget constructor, post-construction nested evaluation failure, index exhaustion and wrong Page binding. Scalar, borrowed-state, source-integrity and typed-receipt checks pass.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes eight complete 64-dimensional fixtures and 202 occupied-cell scans. A Git-free export passes both commands without changing file hashes. Scoped Ruff, package pins/metadata, local links and 74 workflow tests pass, with seven workflow skips. Separate internal source/proof/checker review and replay pass; no independent human review is claimed.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-adapter-numerical-lifecycle
```

Submission refresh checked canonical main `6ca6f217708b075814de409ad693fea9a2aaa760`, unchanged guidance/selection/runner and all dependency heads. Complete metadata pagination covered 717 open PRs and 1,423 Discussion records without warnings; searches exclude arbitrary code diffs.

The bound concerns successful numerical content under the pinned source contracts. Finite fixtures do not establish selected-catalogue membership or exhaust cross adapters, nonzero coordinates and nonuniform ancestor weights. The child branch, surrounding caller residents, serialized tapes, backing capacity, physical placement/movement and full reserve admission remain separate. No selected cold replay, formal-kernel result, hosted-CI pass, new supplier or kappa claim.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

One additive research package; frozen sources and selected-frontier files are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Research

The opt-in replay adds bounded CI work. Applying its allowance to a whole caller still requires an explicit entry-resident and physical-cost ledger.
